dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: Amazing. What a wonderful, eye-opening show.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: Looks like you still got some more counting to do...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: That was a bad move. Today I really learned something. Hard to believe that you can play like this...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: Haha, haha, you gotta quit while you're ahead. That's enough for today!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: Tea Master Liu Su was once my senior. He loves to tell elegant, high-flown stories.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: Me? I don't truck with him and his faux-cultured fellows. What, are the common people unworthy of the storyteller's art, now?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: I don't like the way he rarifies storytelling. This art was originally part of street culture.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: It's like trying to turn offal from the street kitchens into divine elixir... It's just wrong-headed.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: Those who aren't familiar with the art might be entertained, but all the old patrons in attendance know that it's got none of storytelling's original flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: So I'm not sour at all that my senior is famous and earns a lot of money.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: In front of my old patrons, I daresay this much—

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: Were I to go to the Heyu Tea Whatever today and give an oration...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: Don't be so skeptical. If I were to go Heyu Tea House and speak before the ladies and gentlemen of Yujing Terrace...
